9中请用不同颜色首先我们再看看on cloud 9和down in the dumps你怎么知道它们有完全不同的意义?是的,像我们在前面的课程中语言on cloud 9和down in the dumps连接着的语言wile这意味着对比在英语上down and dump都有同样的意义所以,down in the dumps应该是感到沮丧或不愉快而在对比中on cloud 9应该有相反的意义感到非常愉快这简单的答案显示了连接着的语言wile是一个对比的信号语言在前面和后面应该有相反的意义因此当我们试图或猜猜语言或语言的意义发现了语言的概念是正确的除了相反的案例语言的概念也可能代表了其他逻辑的关系例如association 承接cause and effect 因果adversity 转折andcoordination 并列and so on现在请与语言合作讨论其他四个语言的意义根据环境的语言并解释这些语言通过指导问题和语言指导在下方您有五分钟的时间请不吝点赞 订阅 转发 转发您的工作怎么样让我们分享答案We can find some contextual clues both within and outside the sentence.Within the sentence, the phrase poor health is a key clue.It connects to bad feelings such as unhappiness, depression, and low spirits.Outside, the topic of the sentence is a key clue.Outside, the topic sentence, health is another key contributor to happiness, helps the reader understand the opposite idea that poor health causes unhappiness, low spirits, depression.So, there is a relation of contrast between them.I think if a person is worried about the exams, he must be in low spirits.So, the idiom feeling blue communicates unhappy feelings.The coordinating relationship between worrying too much and feeling blue suggests that feeling blue must be a negative feeling.Exams are also likely to arouse negative feelings of low spirits, anxiety, and nervousness in feeling blue.Great job!It seems that most of you can find clues in the context and make reasonable inferences.But can you guess why the writer uses so many idioms about happiness and sadness in one passage?Yes, the writer uses these idioms to avoid using happiness and sadness repeatedly, to arouse our awareness of the diverse and rich expressions of the English language, and most of all to make the language more vivid.We can see from the passage that using idioms properly can highlight the language you use.Now, I would like to show you four more idioms in the context.Please work in pairs.Read the four short paragraphs together and the inferred meanings of the idioms.Then finish the matching task on your worksheet.You will have two minutes for the tasks.星晴之夜為何未能相見星晴之夜時間到了現在我們要來查看答案先來配合它們的意義三月天會有A意見是極樂A lump in the throat goes with D, meaning a feeling of tightness or dryness in the throat, caused by strong emotion, especially sadness.Go through the roof goes with B, meaning suddenly become very angry.Have butterflies goes with C, meaning have a nervous feeling in your stomach before doing something.Great, but I want to hear what clues you have found about these idioms.I think in seventh heaven means extremely happy.There is an obvious clue so excited just following the idiom in seventh heaven.I have also found some other clues like I was really happy for him.Also, he'd silenced all the doubters.He threw a party and he invited me.So the man must have achieved a great success and was feeling extremely happy.I think a lump in the throat probably means a feeling of tightness or dryness in the throat, caused by strong emotion, especially sadness.I have found the clues like I'm a very emotional person.My eyes well up.Big man don't cry.I hold back the tears.From these clues, I can infer that the man must be a very emotional person who cries a lot.I am pretty sure that go through the roof means suddenly become very angry.This short paragraph is about a conflict in the family.The key clue is Tom has a short temper, so it wasn't a good idea.So we can note that Tom went very angry with Peter.I think have butterflies most probably means have a very nervous feeling in your stomach before doing something.The clue is that he had such a feeling when he goes on court.And also in what the man says, you never play well unless you are a bit nervous, which means he doesn't deny his nervous feeling before the game, but also has the confidence in himself.Please share your own personal experiences and feelings using one of the idioms you have learned.For example, I would like to share I fell on top of the world the moment I knew that my son was admitted to his dream music school.You will have 30 seconds to get ready for that.Now I'd like to invite some of you to share your experiences and feelings.I had butterflies in my stomach the first time I was in the piano recital.The delicious homemade cakes my grandma bakes always make me on cloud nine.I always feel blue when I don't get enough sleep.I was over the moon when I received a letter from a long lost friend.My father used to go through the roof when he saw my poor scores.Excellent sharing.I'd like to vivid the descriptions of your personal experiences and feelings.Now please work in groups of four.Make a list of the factors mentioned in the passage that make us happy or sad.Discuss in groups the order of importance of these factors.Report the result to the class and explain the reasons.You should use at least one idiom learned in this class.You will have three minutes for this task.Now let's share one group's work.These are the factors they listed that make us happy and sad,and the ranks of their importance.Now please listen to their information.Report the results to the class and explain the reasons.Now please listen to their explanations.As far as I'm concerned,health is the most important factor contributing to happiness.Nothing is more important than health.If we don't have enough money, we can work to earn it.If we don't have good houses, we can build them with our own hands.However, if we don't have good health, we may struggle to do everything.That's why we need to keep a balanced diet and exercise on a regular basis.In addition to health, friends are also an important part of my life.I always feel better when I'm with friends than when I'm alone.They fill my life with sunshine.I'm always in seventh heaven when we get together.I'm glad to see you have already grasped the essence of happiness.This is your homework for today.Thanks for watching.See you next time.
